Very probably the "Evangelist Sulpicio Y. Munasque of the United Evangelical Church" who arrived in General Santos (then Dadiangas) from Lala, Lanao del Norte on 7 March 1939; in 1941 he and his wife asked Gen. facts.notes: no outside record of the named individuals found
